dialogue.content: (こんにちは。今日はよろしくお願いします！)
dialogue.English: (Hello. I'm looking forward to our session today!)

dialogue.content: （よろしくお願いします）
dialogue.English: (Yes, me too.)

dialogue.content: （もしもよろしければ、時間前ですが開始してしまうのはどうでしょうか？）
dialogue.English: (If it's alright with you, how about we start a bit early?)

dialogue.content: （はい、よろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.English: (Yes, that’s fine. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございます。では開始いたしましょう）
dialogue.English: (Thank you. Let’s get started.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたくない、けど、行かなきゃいけない
dialogue.English: I don’t want to go to school, but I have to.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。行きたくないのにいかなければならない。。
dialogue.English: I see... You don’t want to go, but you feel you must...

dialogue.content: つらいですね
dialogue.English: That must be tough.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうして学校に行きたくないと感じるのか、詳しくお話きかせていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more about what makes you feel you don’t want to go to school?

dialogue.content: 笑顔でいたく無くても、笑顔でいなきゃならないし
dialogue.English: Even if I don't feel like smiling, I have to force a smile.

dialogue.content: 本当のこと言うのは我慢しなきゃならない
dialogue.English: And I have to hold back from saying how I really feel.

dialogue.content: そうなのね。。無理に笑顔を作っていたら、心も身体もへとへとになってしまうね。。
dialogue.English: I see... Forcing yourself to smile must be exhausting for both your mind and body.

dialogue.content: 疲れます
dialogue.English: It’s tiring.

dialogue.content: もしよければ、年齢と何とよんだらいいか、教えてくれるかな？
dialogue.English: If you don't mind, could you tell me your age and what you'd like me to call you?

dialogue.content: 中学1年、さやです
dialogue.English: I'm in my first year of middle school. I'm Saya.

dialogue.content: さやさん、ありがとう。
dialogue.English: Thank you, Saya.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 言いたいことも我慢しているのね？
dialogue.English: So you're holding back the things you want to say, too?

dialogue.content: 仲間外れになりたくない
dialogue.English: I don’t want to be left out.

dialogue.content: うんうん、その気持ち、すごくわかるよ。。。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. I really understand that feeling...

dialogue.content: でも、
dialogue.English: But...

dialogue.content: 仲間はずれにならないよう、心も身体もへとへとになってしまっているさやさん、
dialogue.English: Saya, you're wearing yourself out, mind and body, to avoid being left out,

dialogue.content: 心配です。。もう少し、詳しくどんな毎日を過ごしているのか教えてくれるかな？
dialogue.English: and I'm worried about you... Could you tell me a bit more about what your days are like?

dialogue.content: グループはあるんだけど、
dialogue.English: Well, I have a group of friends, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 1人が悩んでいて、みんなで相談にのってあげたりする
dialogue.English: One of us is struggling, and we all try to give her advice and support.

dialogue.content: そうなのね！それだけ聞いたら、素晴らしい！
dialogue.English: I see! Just hearing that, it sounds wonderful!

dialogue.content: 仲間外れにならないよう、私も相談に乗ってあげるの
dialogue.English: To avoid being left out, I also join in and give advice.

dialogue.content: って、思うけれど。。。
dialogue.English: That's what I would think, but...

dialogue.content: 疲れる
dialogue.English: It’s exhausting.

dialogue.content: さやさんも一生懸命お話聞いているのね。それで疲れちゃう、、、
dialogue.English: You’re listening very hard to others, and that leaves you worn out...

dialogue.content: がんばっているね！！
dialogue.English: You're working so hard.

dialogue.content: 違うかなって思っても、みんなに合わせる
dialogue.English: Even when I think it’s not right, I go along with everyone.

dialogue.content: 自分の方が苦しいのに、一生懸命ほかの子の相談を乗っているのかな？
dialogue.English: Even though you're struggling yourself, are you trying hard to help others with their problems?

dialogue.content: 私の弱音は吐けない
dialogue.English: I can't show any weakness.

dialogue.content: そうなのね。。。一生懸命みんなを助けてあげているのに、
dialogue.English: I see... Even though you’re working so hard to help everyone,

dialogue.content: さやさんは誰が助けてくれるんだろう。。。っていう気持ちになるね
dialogue.English: it must make you feel like, "but who's going to help me?"

dialogue.content: ていうか、合わせるの、頑張るの大変だなぁ〜って、疲れた
dialogue.English: I mean, it's just so hard trying to fit in and push myself. I'm tired.

dialogue.content: 学校行かなければ、楽だけど、試験もあるし、、
dialogue.English: It would be easier if I didn't have to go to school, but there are exams...

dialogue.content: そうだね、合わせるのはつらい。本当につらいんだよね！！！すごくわかるよ
dialogue.English: I know, trying to fit in is painful. It's really, really hard. I completely understand.

dialogue.content: 勉強も頑張っているね！！
dialogue.English: And you're working hard on your studies, too.

dialogue.content: すごい！！！！
dialogue.English: That’s amazing!

dialogue.content: あんまり出来ないけど
dialogue.English: I'm not doing that well, though.

dialogue.content: ううん、そんなことない。さやさんがんばること、いっぱいがんばってる。
dialogue.English: No, that’s not true. You’re putting so much effort into so many things, Saya.

dialogue.content: がんばりすぎて、ちょっと疲れちゃったね
dialogue.English: You've been trying too hard and have gotten a bit worn out.

dialogue.content: 前に失敗したから
dialogue.English: Because I messed up before.

dialogue.content: 前にどんな失敗したのかな？
dialogue.English: What kind of mistake was it that happened before?

dialogue.content: 小学校の時、嫌なことあった
dialogue.English: Something bad happened in elementary school.

dialogue.content: 私が悪かったの
dialogue.English: It was my fault.

dialogue.content: 自己中だった
dialogue.English: I was selfish.

dialogue.content: そうなのね？どんなことがあったのか教えてくれるかな？
dialogue.English: I see. Could you tell me what happened?

dialogue.content: 私が自分勝手だったこと気がつかなかった。
dialogue.English: I didn’t realize I was being selfish.

dialogue.content: クラスの問題になって、謝りました。
dialogue.English: It became a problem for the whole class, and I apologized.

dialogue.content: そんなことがあったのね！どうしてそう感じたのか、教えてくれるかな？
dialogue.English: So that's what happened. Could you tell me why you felt that way?

dialogue.content: そうなんだ。。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 中学になって
dialogue.English: When I got to middle school,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: やり直さなきゃって思って
dialogue.English: I felt I had to start over.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうかそうか！！！
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm, I see, I see!

dialogue.content: 同じにならないようにと思ってる
dialogue.English: I'm trying not to make the same mistake.

dialogue.content: 部活もいまいちで、楽しめない
dialogue.English: My club activities aren't going well either, and I can't enjoy them.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね！小学校の時の反省を生かして、いま、頑張っているんだね！！
dialogue.English: I see! So you're learning from what happened in elementary school and trying hard now!

dialogue.content: 部活は何を頑張っているの？
dialogue.English: What club are you in?

dialogue.content: 吹奏楽部です
dialogue.English: I’m in the concert band.

dialogue.content: すてきだね！楽しめないの？
dialogue.English: That's wonderful! But you can't enjoy it?

dialogue.content: 顧問の先生の言い方がキツいの
dialogue.English: Our advisor’s way of speaking is harsh.

dialogue.content: あらぁ。。きつい先生、怖いね！
dialogue.English: Oh my... A harsh teacher sounds scary.

dialogue.content: 教室を追い出されたりします
dialogue.English: We sometimes get kicked out of the classroom.

dialogue.content: わぁすごいね！きつい！！先生！！
dialogue.English: Wow, that's intense! What a harsh teacher!

dialogue.content: うまく出来なかったらそうなるの？
dialogue.English: Does that happen if you can't play well?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 優しい先輩も怒られてます
dialogue.English: Even the kind upperclassmen get yelled at.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、、、みんな怒られているんだ、、
dialogue.English: I see... so everyone gets yelled at...

dialogue.content: ちょっと話を戻してもいいかな？
dialogue.English: May I circle back for a moment?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Sure.

dialogue.content: 小学校の時の話、本当にさやさんが悪かったのかな？
dialogue.English: About what happened in elementary school... was it really all your fault, Saya?

dialogue.content: 先生も両親も一緒に考えてくれて、私が謝りました
dialogue.English: My teacher and parents thought it through with me, and I apologized.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、、、一体なにがあったのか、教えてくれるかな？
dialogue.English: I see... Can you tell me exactly what happened?

dialogue.content: 自分ではそう思って無かったんだけど、いじめしてた。
dialogue.English: I didn't think of it that way myself, but I was bullying someone.

dialogue.content: そっか。。。さやさんは自覚なかったけど、結果的にいじめだよって、
dialogue.English: I see... So you weren't aware of it, but in the end, it was considered bullying...

dialogue.content: 先生やお父さんお母さんに言われたの？
dialogue.English: Is that what your teacher and parents told you?

dialogue.content: 思い出したくないこと聞いてごめんね
dialogue.English: I’m sorry for asking about something you’d rather not remember.

dialogue.content: 反省しました
dialogue.English: I reflected on it.

dialogue.content: 反省してえらい！！！でも、自分はこういう気持ちだったんだよ！って、
dialogue.English: It’s commendable that you reflected on it! But were you able to say, “This is how I felt,”

dialogue.content: 言えた？そして先生、ご両親、聞いてくれた？
dialogue.English: Were you able to say it? And did your teacher and parents listen?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、さやさん、とても素直な子だね。でも、
dialogue.English: I see. You're a very honest person, Saya. But...

dialogue.content: 大人のいうことがいつも正しいわけではないよね
dialogue.English: What adults say isn't always right, you know.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか？
dialogue.English: Is that so?

dialogue.content: さやさんの気持ち、ちゃんと、大人たちは受け止めてくれたかな？
dialogue.English: Do you feel the adults truly accepted your feelings?

dialogue.content: どうだろうか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: 受け止めてくれたように、さやさんは、感じた？
dialogue.English: Did you feel like they accepted them?

dialogue.content: 親は優しかったし、
dialogue.English: My parents were kind,

dialogue.content: そっか！
dialogue.English: I see!

dialogue.content: 先生は心配してくれてました
dialogue.English: and my teacher was concerned about me.

dialogue.content: そっかそっか、そうしたら、私が心配しすぎたのかな？
dialogue.English: I see, I see. In that case, maybe I was worrying too much?

dialogue.content: ご両親は、いつでもさやさんの味方してくれるかい？
dialogue.English: Are your parents always on your side?

dialogue.content: 怒られることもあります
dialogue.English: They get angry with me sometimes.

dialogue.content: 怒られるのね。親が怒るのは、愛情が深いからなのだけど。。。
dialogue.English: They get angry, I see. Parents often get angry because they care so deeply, but...

dialogue.content: おとうさん、おかあさん、さやさんの気持ち、しっかり聞いてくれるかい？
dialogue.English: Do your mother and father listen carefully to how you feel?

dialogue.content: あんまり心配かけたくないと思ってます
dialogue.English: I try not to worry them too much.

dialogue.content: うーん。心配かけなくて自分のこと言えないことあるように感じました。
dialogue.English: Hmm. It seems like not wanting to worry them might keep you from talking about yourself.

dialogue.content: 間違ってたら間違ってるって言ってね！
dialogue.English: Please tell me if I'm wrong!

dialogue.content: 前みたいな迷惑かけたら、かわいそうだから、、
dialogue.English: I'd feel sorry for them if I caused trouble like before...

dialogue.content: 本当に優しいね、さやさん、、、そうしたら
dialogue.English: You’re truly kind, Saya... In that case,

dialogue.content: 現在のお話に戻ってもいいかな？
dialogue.English: may we return to what’s happening now?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今、さやさんは、前の失敗を繰り返さないように、無理に笑顔、言いたいことも我慢してへとへとです。
dialogue.English: Right now, to avoid repeating your past mistake, you're forcing yourself to smile and holding back what you want to say, and you're exhausted.

dialogue.content: がんばってがんばって、
dialogue.English: You keep pushing yourself and pushing yourself,

dialogue.content: 疲れちゃっている。。。このことは、お父さんお母さん知っているかな？
dialogue.English: and you’re worn out... Do your parents know about this?

dialogue.content: うーん、、知らないと思います
dialogue.English: Hmm... I don’t think they do.

dialogue.content: それはなぜ？
dialogue.English: Why is that?

dialogue.content: 言ってないから
dialogue.English: Because I haven’t told them.

dialogue.content: さっきも言っていたように、心配かけたくないから？
dialogue.English: Is it because, as you said earlier, you don’t want to worry them?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そっか。。。さやさん、お友達にも気を使って、おとうさん、おかあさんにも気を使っていて、
dialogue.English: I see... You’re being considerate of your friends and also of your parents,

dialogue.content: とっても優しい方なんだな、と思いました。。。。でも、
dialogue.English: and I was thinking what a very kind person you are... But,

dialogue.content: 誰がさやさんのつらい気持ちを助けてくれるのかなって。。。
dialogue.English: I wonder who is there to help you with your painful feelings...

dialogue.content: そう思いました
dialogue.English: That's what I was thinking.

dialogue.content: 誰もいない
dialogue.English: There's no one.

dialogue.content: そっかそっか。。つらい！！！！！
dialogue.English: I see, I see... That’s so painful.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もちろん、私は全力でさやさんの味方なのだけれど、
dialogue.English: Of course, I’m completely on your side, but...

dialogue.content: 身近にさやさんを助けてくれるひとがいないのが、とてもつらいね。。。
dialogue.English: it must be very hard not to have someone close by to help you...

dialogue.content: もし、おとうさん、お母さんに、今学校でつらいことを話したらどう思うかな？
dialogue.English: If you told your mom and dad about how hard things are at school right now, how do you think they would react?

dialogue.content: 悲しませる
dialogue.English: It would make them sad.

dialogue.content: 悲しませちゃうかな？さやさんがつらくてもひとり耐えて頑張っていること、おとうさんおかあさん気づいてあげられなくて、悲しいんじゃないかな
dialogue.English: Do you think it would make them sad? Or maybe they would be sad that they didn't realize you were enduring this all alone and trying so hard?

dialogue.content: わかんない
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: そしたら、学校で、無理に笑顔つくらず、言いたいことも我慢せず、
dialogue.English: In that case, if at school you didn't force a smile and didn't hold back what you wanted to say,

dialogue.content: 言ってみたら、お友達はどう思うかな？
dialogue.English: how do you think your friends would react?

dialogue.content: 私がボッチになるかも
dialogue.English: I might end up all alone.

dialogue.content: そうかな？本当の友達は、さやさんが素でいてくれるのが、
dialogue.English: Do you think so? I think real friends would be happy if you could just be your true self.

dialogue.content: 嬉しいんだと思うけどな。さやさんも逆の立場だったらそうでしょ？
dialogue.English: I think they'd be happy. Wouldn't you feel the same way if you were in their shoes?

dialogue.content: 1人ずつだとね
dialogue.English: If it's one-on-one, yes.

dialogue.content: 一人ずつだと？？
dialogue.English: One-on-one?

dialogue.content: グループじゃなくて、一人ずつの関係だとってことかな？
dialogue.English: Do you mean in one-on-one relationships, rather than in a group?

dialogue.content: グループでいる時と、2人で話すときとは、違う感じ
dialogue.English: It feels different when we're in a group compared to when it's just the two of us talking.

dialogue.content: 1人だけ本音言える子はいるけど
dialogue.English: There is one person I can be honest with, though.

dialogue.content: そうか。その子と話している時はさやさん頑張らなくていいんだね
dialogue.English: I see. So when you're talking with that person, you don't have to try so hard.

dialogue.content: な、感じ
dialogue.English: Something like that.

dialogue.content: そっかそっか！！そのことの関係、大事にしていけたらいいね！
dialogue.English: I see, I see! It would be great if you could cherish your relationship with her.

dialogue.content: でも、作り笑顔のことは言わない
dialogue.English: But I don't tell her about the forced smiles.

dialogue.content: ひかれると思うから
dialogue.English: Because I think she'd be put off.

dialogue.content: 一番はさやさんが素でいること！本当のお友達は、そんなことではひかないよ
dialogue.English: The most important thing is for you to be your true self! A real friend wouldn't be put off by something like that.

dialogue.content: そうかなぁ
dialogue.English: You really think so?

dialogue.content: もう少しで時間が来てしまうから少しまとめるね。小学校のことがトラウマになり、現在自分のことが出せなくてつらい思いをしているね。。
dialogue.English: Our time is almost up, so let me summarize a little. What happened in elementary school has become a trauma, and now you're having a hard time because you can't express your true self.

dialogue.content: そして、
dialogue.English: And,

dialogue.content: さやさんにとって一番は、無理せず「素」でいること。」
dialogue.English: the most important thing for you, Saya, is to be your "true self" without forcing it.

dialogue.content: そして、
dialogue.English: And,

dialogue.content: 「人に好かれなくていい。嫌われなければそれでいい」私個人的に、
dialogue.English: "You don't have to be liked by people. As long as you're not disliked, that's enough." Personally,

dialogue.content: この言葉のおかげで心が救われたの。さやさんにもなにか通ずるところがあるかなぁ
dialogue.English: that saying really helped me. I wonder if it might resonate with you, too.

dialogue.content: 好かれなくていいんですか？
dialogue.English: It’s okay not to be liked?

dialogue.content: そう！正しくは、「好かれようとして、必要以上に自分を殺さなくていい」ってこと！
dialogue.English: Yes! More accurately, it means, "You don't have to suppress your true self more than necessary just to be liked."

dialogue.content: ふーん
dialogue.English: Hmm.

dialogue.content: 嫌われるか、好かれるかだと思ってた
dialogue.English: I thought it was either you're liked or you're disliked.

dialogue.content: ちがうよ！素でいると気の合う友達は自然と近くに集まってくるから
dialogue.English: That's not it! If you're your true self, friends you get along with will naturally gather around you.

dialogue.content: 自然に？
dialogue.English: Naturally?

dialogue.content: そうよ！「類は友を呼ぶ」って言葉聞いたことあるかな？
dialogue.English: That's right! Have you ever heard the saying, "Birds of a feather flock together"?

dialogue.content: 知らない
dialogue.English: No, I haven't.

dialogue.content: 作り笑顔していたら、自然と作り笑顔が必要な人が寄ってくるし、
dialogue.English: If you wear a fake smile, you'll naturally attract people who require you to wear a fake smile.

dialogue.content: 素でいたら、素でいても心地よい人が寄ってくるってことだよ！
dialogue.English: And if you're your true self, people who are comfortable with your true self will come to you! That's what it means.

dialogue.content: へー
dialogue.English: Huh.

dialogue.content: 初めて聞いた
dialogue.English: I’ve never heard that before.

dialogue.content: さやさんの素は、優しくて、思いやりのある人だと思うんだ。だから、素でいてね！！
dialogue.English: I think your true self is a kind and considerate person. So please, be yourself!

dialogue.content: きっと、同じような優しい、思いやりのある人が寄ってくるよ！
dialogue.English: I'm sure that other kind and considerate people will gather around you!

dialogue.content: 私の素って何か、お母さんに聞いてみます。
dialogue.English: I’ll ask my mom what my true self is like.

dialogue.content: そうね！お母さん、一番よくさやさんのこと知ってくれていると思うから！
dialogue.English: Yes! I think your mother knows you best, after all!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます♪
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 少し、さやさんの気持ち、楽になったかな？
dialogue.English: Do you feel a little better now, Saya?

dialogue.content: それなら話せそうです。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think I can talk about that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: お母さんは、娘の世界で一番の理解者だからね！怖がらずに、つらいよーって話してみて♪
dialogue.English: A mother is her daughter's biggest supporter in the world! Don't be afraid to try telling her, "I'm having a hard time."

dialogue.content: つらいよーは、まだ話せないと思います
dialogue.English: I don't think I can say, "I'm having a hard time," just yet.

dialogue.content: けど、私の素の話なら聞けそうです
dialogue.English: But I think I can ask her about my true self.

dialogue.content: そっかそっか、ゆっくりで大丈夫よ！
dialogue.English: I see, I see. It's okay to take your time!

dialogue.content: さやさんのこと、応援しているね！つらいよーは、私にまた話てね！！
dialogue.English: I'm cheering for you, Saya! When you feel like you're having a hard time, you can always talk to me again!

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: そうしたら、お時間過ぎちゃってごめんね！つらいよーって、いつでも来てね！
dialogue.English: Alright then, I'm sorry we've gone over time! Please come back anytime you feel you're having a hard time.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 勇気持って話に来てくれて、ありがとう！！
dialogue.English: Thank you for having the courage to come and talk with me today!

dialogue.content: （時間押してしまいすみませんでした。これで終了してもよろしいですか？）
dialogue.English: (I’m sorry for running over time. Is it okay to end here?)

dialogue.content: （は、ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Y-yes, thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: （はい）
dialogue.English: (Yes.)

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)
